content:
Sam: Heads-up — new Senior ML Engineer starts Monday (9am PT). I want a tight week0 agenda and a concise 30/60/90 we can share with them. Can you help, @Anita? :wave:
Anita: yes — I can pull together. quick q: is their buddy confirmed? and do we want a 1:1 with exec on day 3?
Sam: Buddy is tentative (Lisa). Exec 1:1 is helpful but short (20m) — probably day 3. Also need to confirm laptop + VPN pre-provisioning.
Anita: got it. here's a lightweight week0 checklist I propose — lean and actionable:
```
Mon AM: Welcome + logistics (laptop, accounts, M365/GSuite, Slack, OKTA)
Mon PM: Team intro + product overview (30m demo)
Tue: Deep dive w/owner for core infra and codebase walkthrough (pairing)
Wed: Observability + deploy runbook + security intro (1hr)
Thu: First small task assigned (README or tiny bug) + pairing
Fri: 30m sync with manager + 1:1 with buddy + admin wrap-up
```
Anita: Access items to pre-provision: GitHub org, repo write, CI, Redwood Console dev org, sandbox cluster, jumpbox VPN. Add GCP console if needed.
Jorge: On infra side — please open tickets for: service account, k8s namespace, ro access to prod metrics, and Grafana dashboard share. If they need deploy rights, do canary-only role first.
Lisa: I can be buddy Monday–Friday mornings. happy to do a daily 30m pairing slot (10:30–11:00 PT) for first 2 weeks.
Sam: perfect. For the 30/60/90 I want something candidate-facing (high level) + manager-facing (detailed deliverables). Anita, can you draft both?
Anita: yes — draft outline below (will flesh into doc):
- Candidate-facing (one-pager): goals for 30/60/90, key contacts, what success looks like. Keep it plain language.
- Manager-facing: specific checkpoints, deliverables, feedback rubric, suggested learning sprints, and timeline for ramping deploy ownership.
Anita: sample manager-facing milestones (short):
- 30d: setup complete, two small PRs merged, can run tests and read core infra docs; buddy feedback collected
- 60d: owns one service for non-peak hours, demonstrates debugging on incident playbook, contributes to perf evals
- 90d: independent deploys, leads a tech review, measurable improvement in latency/cost for their service (OKR-linked)
people-ops-bot: New hire checklist created: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/1841123456 (auto-generated).
Sam: thanks — can we also include a short "first-week expectations for manager" snippet? like daily 15m standups, weekly feedback checkpoint, and defined first task?
Anita: yes. manager snippet (to include in packet):
- Day 0: confirm workstation + accounts, welcome note in team channel
- Day 1–5: 15m daily sync, 1hr weekly 1:1 scheduled, candidate has three micro-tasks to complete by Friday
- End of week: 30m manager review + buddy input + clear next-week plan
Sam: perfect. last ask — Laura on legal needs the NDA signed before giving access to some datasets. Anita, can you flag that to the candidate email?
Anita: will do. I'll draft the candidate-facing one-pager and the manager doc today and post here for review. tagging Lisa + Jorge for quick access confirmations.
Lisa: ack — will confirm buddy invite and hold morning pairing slots.
Jorge: I'll open infra tickets now and put notes in the ticket about canary-only deploy role.
Sam: awesome. once Anita posts the draft I'll review and then ping hiring manager to send to candidate. :thumbsup:
